mapper.insert: INSERT INTO charge_record(prescription_id, charge_time, amount, cashier_id) VALUES(#{prescriptionId}, #{chargeTime}, #{amount}, #{cashierId})
mapper.select: SELECT charge_id AS chargeId, prescription_id AS prescriptionId, charge_time AS chargeTime, amount, cashier_id AS cashierId FROM charge_record WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId}
